title: Velocity from acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the velocity after acceleration using work-energy theorem: v = sqrt(2eU1/m).

title: Selector voltage derivation
description: Important: Applies force balance in the velocity selector (electric force equals magnetic force) to relate v, B1, d, and U2.

title: Radius from circular motion
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the radius in B2 using Lorentz force as centripetal force: R = (1/B2)*sqrt(2mU1/e).

title: Consistent variable substitution
description: Important: Substitutes the expression for velocity (from part 1) into the equations for U2 and R, showing the chain of reasoning.

title: Correct final expressions
description: Essential: Provides the final algebraic answers for v, U2, and R in the required forms, matching the reference solution.

title: Unit awareness
description: Optional: Mentions or implies correct units for the final quantities (m/s, V, m) or performs a dimensional check.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies the right-hand rule or confuses force directions, leading to an incorrect sign in the velocity selector balance.

title: Algebraic manipulation mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in solving for v, U2, or R (e.g., incorrect exponent, missing factor, or misarranged formula).
